diagrams.title: **Primitives, integrations, platforms
diagrams.caption: **Primitives, integrations, platforms.** Higher layers implement the protocol for you; lower layers give you more control and more plumbing.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 320" aria-label="Three layers of A2A implementation. Bottom: the core protocol layer, the A2A SDK, with protocol primitives such as Message, TextPart, AgentSkill, AgentCapabilities, A2ACardResolver, ClientFactory and ClientConfig. Middle: framework integrations such as Strands A2A with A2AServer and A2AAgent, and Google ADK. Top: platform-specific implementations such as LangSmith Agent Server, managed endpoints for deployed agents." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <rect x="40" y="220" width="1020" height="84" rx="16" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="64" y="254" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">1 Core protocol layer: the A2A SDK (a2a-sdk)</text><text x="64" y="284" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">Message · TextPart · AgentSkill · AgentCapabilities · A2ACardResolver · ClientFactory · ClientConfig</text>
      <rect x="140" y="120" width="820" height="84" rx="16" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="164" y="154" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">2 Framework integrations</text><text x="164" y="184" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">Strands A2A (strands-agents[a2a]): A2AServer, A2AAgent · Google ADK</text>
      <rect x="240" y="20" width="620" height="84" rx="16" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="264" y="54" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">3 Platform-specific implementations</text><text x="264" y="84" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">LangSmith Agent Server: managed endpoints</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **Three processes, one protocol
diagrams.caption: **Three processes, one protocol.** The two agents could be written by different teams in different frameworks; the orchestrator only needs their URLs.
diagrams.svg:

Each agent uses Claude on Amazon Bedrock." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah-proto" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-proto" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>

diagrams.title: **Card first, then message, then task
diagrams.caption: **Card first, then message, then task.** The orchestrator never sees the tool call; the weather agent stays opaque.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 380" aria-label="Protocol flow between the orchestrator and the weather agent. First, GET /.well-known/agent-card.json returns the card with name, description and skills. Then POST / with a JSON-RPC message/stream request carrying 'What is the weather in London?'. The weather agent's LLM calls the get_weather tool. The server streams back events, ending in a task with artifacts containing the answer, 15 degrees C, cloudy with occasional rain." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="40" y="16" width="260" height="60" rx="14" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="170" y="52" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Orchestrator</text>
      <rect x="800" y="16" width="260" height="60" rx="14" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="930" y="52" text-anchor="middle" class="t on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Weather agent :9001</text>
      <path d="M170 76 V366 M930 76 V366" class="ln dash" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:7 7"></path>
      <path d="M174 110 H926" class="ln-data" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah-data)" style="stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path><text x="550" y="102" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">GET /.well-known/agent-card.json</text>
      <path d="M926 150 H174" class="ln-tool" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah-tool)" style="stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path><text x="550" y="142" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">{ name, description, skills, capabilities }</text>
      <path d="M174 200 H926" class="ln-data" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah-data)" style="stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path><text x="550" y="192" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">POST /  JSON-RPC message/stream · "What is the weather in London?"</text>
      <rect x="760" y="226" width="300" height="70" rx="12" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="910" y="256" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">LLM calls get_weather</text><text x="910" y="280" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">inside Agent B, invisible to A</text>
      <path d="M926 330 H174" class="ln-tool" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah-tool)" style="stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path><text x="550" y="322" text-anchor="middle" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">SSE events, ending in a task with artifacts: "15°C, cloudy…"</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **Different layers, no overlap
diagrams.caption: **Different layers, no overlap.** A2A lets agents collaborate; MCP lets each agent do its own work with tools and data.
